Good to know

A few answers.
Before you scan.

Recovery is a possibility, not a promise. Here’s what to expect.

Can every deleted file be recovered?

No. Results depend on available copies, permissions, Android storage rules and the condition of your device. Overwritten data or files lost after a factory reset may not be recoverable. A scan may also find existing files, thumbnails or cached copies rather than a deleted original.

Can I check a photo before saving it?

Yes. Open a photo preview and review available file details before selecting it for recovery. Preview quality and the quality of the file that can be saved may vary.

What can I do with duplicate files?

Review duplicate-file groups and choose the copies you want to remove. Always check your selection before confirming deletion. Cleanup and recovery are separate actions.

Does this recover files from cloud accounts?

Lost File Recovery focuses on accessible device files. Files that exist only in a cloud service are outside this recovery flow. Check that service’s own trash or backup features.

Where can I read about data and permissions?

Read our Privacy policy for information about file access, optional notification recovery, technical data and your choices. Contact support if you have questions.
